title: A quasi-finite polynomial factorization bounds the fibre dimensions on its principal open
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with S a finite type R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Let g in S and n be a natural number. Suppose f: R[t_1,...,t_n] -> S_g is an R-algebra homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring, def-weil-ring-localization-away], is finite type, and is quasi-finite at every prime [def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime]. For every prime q of S not containing g, put p = q cap R and let Q be the prime of the fibre ring kappa(p) tensor_R S corresponding to q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then the local topological Krull dimension of this fibre spectrum at Q is at most n [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point].

proof.text: Put $p=q\cap R$, $k=\kappa(p)$, $F=k\otimes_R S$, $T=k\otimes_R S_g$, and $P=R[t_1,\ldots,t_n]$. Construct $\varphi:k[t_1,\ldots,t_n]\to T$ as the tensor-product map $1\otimes f$ composed with the inverse polynomial scalar-extension isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-polynomial-scalar-extension]. The coefficient-map compatibility follows from the formula taking the image of a polynomial in $P$ back to $1\otimes$ that polynomial. Every element of $T$ is a finite sum $\sum_i a_i\otimes s_i=\sum_i(1\otimes s_i)\varphi(C(a_i))$. Thus the square with rings $P,S_g,k[t_1,\ldots,t_n],T$ has exactly the finite-sum generation property of [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-finite-four-rings]. That theorem proves that $\varphi$ is finite type and quasi-finite at every prime, using the given quasi-finiteness at the contraction of each prime. This is the fully proved private helper polynomial_factorization_baseChange; it works over any commutative R-algebra A, not just k.

The polynomial ring $k[t_1,\ldots,t_n]$ is finite type over $k$, and $\varphi$ is finite type by step 1. Their composite makes $T$ finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-quasi-finite-over-polynomial-algebra] to $\varphi$ to get $\dim\operatorname{Spec}T\le n$. The scalar tower is justified directly by the k-algebra homomorphism identity for $\varphi$.

Construct the canonical map $j:F\to T$ by tensoring $S\to S_g$ with k. Localization commutes with tensor base change [lem-weil-pbc-localization-base-change]; the precise Mathlib form used is IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right, whose compatibility condition is checked on $1\otimes s$. The image of the powers of g consists of the powers of $b=1\otimes g$, so $T$ is an away localization of $F$ at b. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-localization-away-basic-open], contraction along j is an open embedding with range $D(b)$. Its homeomorphism onto that range identifies the global dimensions of $\operatorname{Spec}T$ and $D(b)$. Therefore $\dim D(b)\le n$.

Let Q be the fibre prime for q. The inverse of [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-ring-primes-bijection] is contraction along the right tensor inclusion, so its inverse-application identity gives $Q\cap S=q$. Thus $b\notin Q$ follows from $g\notin q$, and Q belongs to the open neighbourhood $D(b)$. By the infimum defining local dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], $\dim_Q\operatorname{Spec}F\le\dim D(b)\le n$. In Lean this is iInf₂_le at the neighbourhood PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen b followed by the bound from step 3. No localized prime qg or equality of local dimensions on open subspaces is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem fibre_dimension_le_of_quasiFinite_polynomial_localization
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [FiniteType R S] (g : S) (n : ℕ)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →ₐ[R] Localization.Away g)
    (hft : @FiniteType (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away g)
      _ _ f.toRingHom.toAlgebra)
    (hq : ∀ qg : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away g),
      @IsQuasiFiniteAtPrime (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away g)
        _ _ f.toRingHom.toAlgebra hft qg)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) (hg : g ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt
      (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S))
        ⟨q, rfl⟩) ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
